payload.title: Member and reader edits go through the Proposals queue
payload.description: Web 2.0 variant. Member and reader edits are Proposals (`fileProposal`, rename and merge kinds already exist), moderated with the optional AI moderation, accepted by an editor or auto-accepted for trusted members. Credit on the page, history, reversal. Blocked: reader sign-in stays closed in production until Prospectus returns a site subject, and the rule forbids adding a flag around that. A site with `members` needs a membership source; decide with Prospectus.
